_comment: Canonical CREATE2 v1.0.2 escrow-dependent contracts. Salt namespace `x402r-canonical-v1.0.2::*`. Currently PaymentOperatorFactory only: bumped from v1.0.1 because its source changed — the factory embeds `type(PaymentOperator).creationCode`, and the operator's 6-arg `charge` alignment shifts the factory's initCodeHash and CREATE2 address. The other five escrow-dependent contracts are unchanged and stay in canonical-v1.0.1.json. Derive via `_deploy2` (dry-run DeployX402r.s.sol on any chain where the canonical escrow is live). Verify on-chain with `cast code <address> --rpc-url <chain>` — non-empty output proves the canonical address is live on that chain.
